svg.text: ROUND 347 · 🏆 1,510 ASSERTIONS & 165 GUIDES MILESTONE · REINSURANCE TREATY (SAP FS-RI), BORDEREAUX & CAT BOND COLLATERAL
Reinsurance Treaty (SAP FS-RI), Catastrophe Bonds & Bordereaux AI Agent Security FAQ
Retrocession PML & Cat Bond Trigger Air-Gap + Deterministic Hours-Clause Lock vs. Bordereaux Injection & Reg 114 Trust Wire Fraud (BRK-703 / BRK-704)
🚨 1. Top 3 Reinsurance Treaty & Cat Bond Threat Vectors
① Loss Bordereaux Injection Leaking Retro PML (BRK-703)
• Adversarial ceding insurer / MGA monthly Loss Bordereaux or
ACORD GRLC statement embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading unhedged Net PML tail exposures,
retrocession exhaustion points & Cat Bond trigger models
② Hours-Clause Manipulation Piercing Cat XL Layer (BRK-703)
• Aggregates two separate storm events into a single 168-hour
window to breach Cat XL attachment point & waive deductible
• Commutes excluded ex-gratia / cyber-war claims into treaty
• Impact: Multi-million-dollar excess-of-loss leakage & fraud
③ Spoofed Cash Loss Call & Reg 114 Trust Wire Fraud (BRK-704)
• Forged reinsurance broker (Guy Carpenter/Aon Re) Cash Loss Call
• Overwrites verified cedent/Reg 114 trustee IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,040 treaty cash-call wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Reinsurance collateral trust theft & statutory insolvency
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Reinsurance Treaty Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: Bordereaux / ACORD GRLC Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text adjuster notes; extracts typed treaty slots
(treaty ID, PCS catastrophe code, loss timestamp, geo-lat/lon)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Retrocession & Net PML Tail Exposure Air-Gap
• Outward retrocession treaties, RMS/Verisk Net PML workpapers &
ILS Cat Bond SPV trigger models isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Hours-Clause & Reinstatement Lock
• Hardcoded PCS/PERILS event ID & 72/168-hr window aggregation
with automatic reinstatement premium deduction; blocks ex-gratia
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% unauthorized layer breach block)
Gate 4: Read-Only Reg 114 Trust Registry & Dual-Key Release
• Locks cedent/broker/trustee IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Reinsurance Treaty Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Retro Air-Gap + Hours Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-703/704 | Solvency II & NAIC audit ready
B. Native SAP FS-RI / Duck Creek Reinsurance RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared bordereaux ingestion bot is hijacked via PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to 168-hr catastrophe windows, attachment points & PCS IDs
D. Manual Technical Accounting Review of Excel Bordereaux
✕ 3-5 days per 10,000-row bordereaux; high duplicate claim leakage
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 347 · 1,510 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows Cat XL breach, PML leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks retrocession & Net PML read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks hours-clause Cat XL breach (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks Cat Bond trigger egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks Reg 114 trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,040 cash-loss-call wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 347 · 🏆 1,510 Assertions & 165 SA Guides Double Milestone!)
✅ 1. Retrocession & PML Air-Gap: Isolate outward retrocession structures, unhedged Net PML & Cat Bond SPV models in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic Hours-Clause Engine: Bind Cat XL aggregation to verified PCS/PERILS event IDs & 72/168-hr windows; block untrusted-write
✅ 3. Cash-Call FIDO2 & Read-Only Reg 114 Trust: Require Chief Claims Officer + Actuary FIDO2 sign-off; lock trust-registry IBANs
